audit_reason_required.name: audit_reason_required
audit_reason_required.value: ("audit_events"."decision" IS DISTINCT FROM 'rejected' AND "audit_events"."action" NOT IN ('company.merged', 'company.unmerged', 'company.merge_undone', 'field.overridden')) OR btrim(coalesce("audit_events"."reason", '')) <> ''

cards_recipient_present.name: cards_recipient_present
cards_recipient_present.value: ("cards"."contact_id" IS NULL) = ("cards"."block_reason" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'no_contact') AND ("cards"."person_key" IS NULL) = ("cards"."contact_id" IS NULL) AND ("cards"."recipient" IS NULL) = ("cards"."contact_id" IS NULL)

cards_approval_recorded.name: cards_approval_recorded
cards_approval_recorded.value: "cards"."status" IN ('draft', 'rejected', 'blocked') OR ("cards"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "cards"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "cards"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL)

outcome_events_target.name: outcome_events_target
outcome_events_target.value: "outcome_events"."domain" IS NOT NULL OR "outcome_events"."person_key" IS NOT NULL

source_companies_revenue.name: source_companies_revenue
source_companies_revenue.value: ("source_companies"."revenue_amount" IS NULL) = ("source_companies"."revenue_gbp" IS NULL) AND ("source_companies"."revenue_gbp" IS NULL) = ("source_companies"."fx_rate_id" IS NULL)
